Hi Marta,

Thank you for contacting us. When you place an order, we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when your order ships. It's common to see both a pending authorization and a settled charge appear for a day or two, which can look like a double charge—the pending one drops off automatically within five business days.

If this doesn't resolve the issue, a specialist will follow up with you to investigate further.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for reaching out! You can download an invoice for order 49001 directly from your Orders page in your account. This should provide the itemized documentation your company needs for reimbursement.

If you have trouble locating it or need further assistance, a specialist will follow up with you.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Amelia,

I'm sorry you're having trouble accessing your account. Unfortunately, the information I have available doesn't cover login issues. A specialist will follow up with you shortly to help resolve this and get you back into your account.

Thank you for your patience!

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Ravi,

Thank you for reaching out. I understand you're having trouble signing in after replacing your phone and losing access to your authenticator app.

This is a security issue that requires specialized assistance. A specialist from our team will follow up with you shortly to help restore your account access.

We appreciate your patience!

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Lucía,

Thank you for contacting us. I understand your concern about order 49087.

You can track your order's status on the Orders page of your account. Once your package leaves our warehouse, you'll see the carrier name and tracking number there. The carrier's tracking page updates within 24 hours of the first scan.

If tracking hasn't updated for more than three business days, the package may be delayed at a carrier hub. In that case, we can open a trace with the carrier, which usually resolves within five business days.

A specialist will follow up with you shortly to investigate further.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Owen,

Thanks for reaching out! Orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave our warehouse the same day. Once your package ships, you'll find the carrier name and tracking number on your Orders page, and you can use that to get delivery estimates for Vancouver.

For specific arrival timeframes with expedited shipping, a specialist will follow up with you shortly.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Hana,

Thank you for contacting us about your order. I'm sorry to hear you received the wrong item. A specialist will follow up with you shortly to help resolve this issue and get you the correct women's medium fleece.

Please have your order number ready when they reach out.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Karim,

Thank you for contacting us. According to our refund timeline, refunds to the original payment method are issued within five business days after your return arrives at our warehouse. Your bank may then take an additional three to ten business days to display the credit on your statement.

Since two weeks have passed, a specialist will follow up with you shortly to investigate the status of your return. Please have your order number ready for that conversation.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Beatriz,

Thank you for contacting us about your tent pole issue. I'm sorry to hear about the damage to your Summit 2 tent.

Unfortunately, the product care information I have available doesn't cover tent pole repairs or replacements. A specialist will follow up with you shortly to discuss this further and find the best solution.

We appreciate your business and will help resolve this.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Felix,

Thanks for reaching out. It sounds like your shell's waterproof coating may have worn down with use. When water stops beading on the fabric, we recommend washing the jacket with a technical-fabric wash and then applying a spray-on re-proofing treatment. This restores the coating and won't affect your warranty.

If you'd like personalized guidance on your specific jacket, a specialist will follow up with you shortly.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for reaching out! The information I have available covers order tracking procedures, but doesn't address shipping to APO addresses. This is an important question, and I want to make sure you get accurate details about our shipping options.

A specialist will follow up with you shortly to help with your gift shipment to your family member's military address.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Sven,

Thanks for reaching out! I'd be happy to help with your question about your order. Could you please provide more details about what you'd like to know? 

In the meantime, here's some general information: Standard shipping typically takes three to six business days after your order leaves our warehouse, while express shipping takes one to two business days. Estimates shown at checkout are counted from the shipping date, not the order date.

If you have specific concerns about your order, a specialist will follow up with you shortly.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Chiara,

Thank you for reaching out. I don't have information about discount codes or how they're applied in our system. A specialist will follow up with you shortly to look into the summer15 code and what happened at checkout.

We appreciate your patience!

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Mohammed,

Thank you for reaching out! Yes, we can help with that. We're able to merge two accounts so all your orders and rewards points appear in one place.

To get started, please provide us with both email addresses and let us know which account you'd like to keep. The merge takes one business day to complete.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Grace,

Thank you for reaching out. To ensure your recent order is sent to your new address, please contact our specialist team as soon as possible—they'll be able to assist you with address changes for pending orders.

You can also check your Orders page to see if your order has already left our warehouse. Once it does, you'll see the carrier name and tracking number, which you can use to monitor its progress.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Pablo,

Thank you for reaching out. Down jackets can appear flat after washing, but this is often reversible. According to our care instructions, tumble drying on low with two or three clean tennis balls helps restore loft to down jackets. We recommend trying this method.

If your jacket doesn't regain its loft after drying with tennis balls, a specialist will follow up with you to discuss next steps.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Yasmin,

Thanks for contacting us! You can return one item while keeping the others—just start the return from your Orders page, select the item you'd like to return, and print the prepaid label.

Since you're requesting a refund rather than an exchange, a flat $7 label fee will be deducted from your return unless the item arrived damaged or we sent you the wrong item.

A specialist will follow up if you have any questions about your specific return.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Tom,

Thanks for contacting us. When you place an order, we authorize the full amount, and a pending authorization can appear on your card for a day or two before dropping off automatically—this is normal even if the order is cancelled.

The pending charge should disappear within five business days. If you still see it after that time, please reach out and we'll be happy to investigate further.

Thanks for your patience!

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Aiko,

Thank you for reaching out. Our article on refund timelines doesn't include information about store credit expiration dates. A specialist will follow up with you shortly to answer your question about whether your store credit has an expiration date.

We appreciate your patience!

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Ben,

Thank you for reaching out about your trekking pole. I don't have information about trekking pole coverage or warranty in our product care documentation. 

A specialist will follow up with you shortly to discuss your situation and help find the best solution.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support
